questions.question: A tyre has two punctures. The first puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 9 min and the second alone would have done it in 6 min. If air leaks out at a constant rate, how long will it take both the punctures together to make the tyre flat?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The first puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 9 min.

The second puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 6 min

**Calculation:**

⇒ In 1 minute, the first puncture can make the tyre flat = (1)/(9)th part

⇒ In 1 minute, second puncture can make the tyre flat = (1)/(6)th part

Together, in 1 minute, both punctures can make the tyre flat = (1)/(9)+(1)/(6)=(15)/(54) th part

⇒ So, time taken for both the punctures to make the tyre flat = ​(54)/(15) minutes = ​(18)/(5) = 3​(3)/(5) minutes.

**Therefore, the time taken for both punctures to make the tyre flat is 3(3)/(5) minutes.**

questions.question: What is the sum of the angle complementary to 15° and the angle supplementary to 125°?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

An angle complementary to 15° and supplementary to 125° 

**Concept Used:**

Complementary angles = when their sum is equal to 90°

Supplementary angles = when their sum is equal to 180°

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the complementary angle be x.

⇒ So, x + 15º = 90º

⇒ x = 90 – 15 = 75º

⇒ Let the supplementary angle be y.

⇒ So, y + 125º = 180º

⇒ y = 180 – 125 = 55º

⇒ Sum of x and y = 75 + 55 = 130º

**Therefore, the sum of the angle complementary to 15° and the angle supplementary to 125° is 130°**

questions.question: A retailer marks all his goods at 50% above the cost price and thinking that he will still make 25% profit, offers a discount of 25% on the marked price. What is his actual profit on the sales?
questions.solution:

Marked Price = 50% above the CP

Discount on MP = 25%

⇒ Marked price of all the goods = 100 + 50% of 100

⇒ Selling Price = 150-(25)/(100)times 150=150-37.5=112.5 Rs

⇒ Profit = SP – CP

⇒ Profit = 112.5 – 100 = Rs 12.5

⇒ Profit Percentage = (12.5)/(100)times 100=12.5\%

**Therefore, the final profit percentage made on selling all the goods is 12.5%.**
